$schema: "http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#"
title: Multi-pane colour preview

type: object
properties:
  panes:
    type: array
    items:
      type: object
      required:
        - role
        - layers
        - fractalPosition
        - proportion
      properties:
        role:
          type: string
        layers:
          type: object
          additionalProperties:
            type: object
            properties:
              colourRef:
                type: string
            required:
              - colourRef
            additionalProperties: true
        fractalPosition:
          type: string
          enum:
            - Q1
            - Q2
            - Q3
            - Q4
        proportion:
          type: number
          minimum: 0.0
          maximum: 1.0
      additionalProperties: true
required:
  - panes
additionalProperties: true
